Class StandardVirtualThreadExecutor

java.lang.Object
org.apache.catalina.util.LifecycleBase
org.apache.catalina.util.LifecycleMBeanBase
org.apache.catalina.core.StandardVirtualThreadExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Executor, ExecutorService, MBeanRegistration, Executor, JmxEnabled, Lifecycle
public class StandardVirtualThreadExecutor extends LifecycleMBeanBase implements Executor, ExecutorService
An executor that uses a new virtual thread for each task.

    • execute

      public void execute(Runnable command, long timeout, TimeUnit unit)
      Description copied from interface: Executor
      Executes the given command at some time in the future. The command may execute in a new thread, in a pooled thread, or in the calling thread, at the discretion of the Executor implementation. If no threads are available, it will be added to the work queue. If the work queue is full, the system will wait for the specified time until it throws a RejectedExecutionException
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Executor
      Parameters:
      command - the runnable task
      timeout - the length of time to wait for the task to complete
      unit - the units in which timeout is expressed

    • startInternal

      protected void startInternal() throws LifecycleException
      Description copied from class: LifecycleBase
      Subclasses must ensure that the state is changed to LifecycleState.STARTING during the execution of this method. Changing state will trigger the Lifecycle.START_EVENT event. If a component fails to start it may either throw a LifecycleException which will cause it's parent to fail to start, or it can place itself in the error state in which case LifecycleBase.stop() will be called on the failed component but the parent component will continue to start normally.
      Specified by:
      startInternal in class LifecycleBase
      Throws:
      LifecycleException - Start error occurred
